ValidationRule.description: If coupon used on is emd, ticket no and mileage equivalent should not be entered
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Used_On__c, "Mileage" )) && NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_TKT_No__c )) && NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_EMD_No__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please only enter Ticket No. and EMD No. if the coupon is used on this item
